description: Space surface registry: one row per route, event subject, index, cache key family, notification type and preview, with its ZDR class. Authored by hand and by the workstream that adds the surface (same PR); pinned by space-surface.v1.json.sha256 and scripts/tests/zdr-contract-sync.test.sh. Completeness lints: model-gateway zdr_posture (every non-GET route), gateway tests/space_routes_zdr_classes.rs (every /api/v1/spaces route).

zdr_classes.refuse: the surface refuses a ZDR caller or a ZDR-flagged Space with the typed catalogue code
zdr_classes.refs_only: the surface keeps ids and timestamps only under ZDR, never content
zdr_classes.poll_only: no push under ZDR; the caller polls
zdr_classes.local_only: state stays on the client or in memory and is never persisted
zdr_classes.n/a: stores no content (configuration, reads, deletes, ephemeral compute)

route_classes.ReadMetadata: gateway reads ids, roles and labels from Control
route_classes.ModelRead: gateway reads Model Plane state under a Control read decision
route_classes.Config: configuration or access-list write: ids only, allowed under ZDR (K4-14)
route_classes.DurableWrite: durable content write: calls crate::zdr::org_zdr_lookup before minting a decision
route_classes.Chat: a chat turn through the gateway

basis_values.guard:<fn>: the handler calls the named ZDR guard
basis_values.posture-decided: the handler decides the ZDR posture per call
basis_values.path-rule: classified by what the route does, no guard needed
basis_values.registry: classified here; the gateway has no runtime ZDR guard on the route yet
basis_values.unreviewed: no guard found, classified n/a pending review
